info.title: Shared Data Models for Fourletters API
info.description: Shared data models for the fourletters.

ReceiptType.description: 'delivered' = the recipient device received and decrypted the message; 'read' = the user opened it; 'undecryptable' = the recipient received it but could not decrypt it (the message was encrypted to a stale public key, e.g. after the recipient logged in on a new device). A negative acknowledgement: it lets the Server drop the retained copy (no one can decrypt it) and prompts the original sender to re-fetch the recipient's current key and resend once.

RefreshError.description: Body of a 401 from /auth/refresh. 'revoked' means a newer login took over the single active device, on which the client wipes its local E2E identity keys; the other reasons just require re-authentication.

reason.description: 'revoked' = invalidated by a newer login (single-active-device takeover); 'expired' = refresh token past expiry; 'invalid' = malformed/missing or session mismatch.

token.description: The identity token provided by the third-party OAuth provider.

roles.description: List of user permissions/roles for RBAC.

PublicUser.description: A user's public profile as served by the directory: the display name and avatar shown to other users. Contains no roles or private account data.

id.description: The user id this profile belongs to.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's avatar image, if set.

UserBatchResponse.description: Public profiles for a batch of requested user ids. Missing/unknown ids are simply omitted.

messageId.description: Unique identifier for the message generated by the client

recipientId.description: ID of the recipient user. Required for a 1:1 message. Omitted for a group message.

senderId.description: ID of the sender user. Set by the Server from the authenticated session at send time; any client-provided value is ignored. Omitted in the send request.

payload.description: E2E encrypted ciphertext. Format '<sessionType>.<bodyBase64>'. sessionType is 1 (WhisperMessage, established pairwise session) or 3 (PreKeyWhisperMessage, establishes the pairwise session) for a 1:1 payload, or 4 (SenderKeyMessage) for a group payload encrypted once with the sender's per-group Sender Key.

messageId.description: ID of the accepted message (echoed from the request).

status.description: The Server has durably taken ownership of the message.

serverStartedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which this Server process started. A changed value across responses signals a restart, after which the client re-submits its unconfirmed outbox messages.

messages.description: The recipient's undelivered messages, in arrival order.

receipts.description: Pending delivery/read acknowledgements for messages this user sent, accumulated while the user was offline. Returned once and then cleared.

serverStartedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which this Server process started. A changed value across responses signals a restart, after which the client re-submits its unconfirmed outbox messages.

MessageReceipt.description: A delivery/read acknowledgement for a message the calling user sent, delivered to the sender via the inbox pull.

messageId.description: ID of the original message being acknowledged.

recipientId.description: ID of the user who delivered/read the message.

signature.description: Signature over (messageId, type, originalSenderId) by the recipient's identity key (Base64), echoed unaltered from the submitted DeliveryReceipt.

MessageBatchRequest.description: Submits several messages in one call — used by the client to re-submit unconfirmed outbox messages after a detected Server restart. Idempotent per messageId.

messages.description: The messages to (re)submit, capped per request; the client chunks larger resyncs.

results.description: Per-message acceptance result, in request order.

serverStartedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which this Server process started (carried once for the whole batch).

messageId.description: ID of the message being acknowledged.

originalSenderId.description: ID of the original message's sender — the party to notify. Echoed by the recipient from the received message so the Server can relay this receipt

signature.description: Signature over (messageId, type, originalSenderId) by the recipient's identity key (Base64). Lets the original sender trust the receipt without trusting any Hub.

ReceiptBatchRequest.description: Submits several signed receipts in one call.

receipts.description: The signed receipts to record, capped per request.

SignedPreKey.description: A Signal signed pre-key: a medium-lived Curve25519 public key signed by the identity key.

keyId.description: Client-assigned id of this signed pre-key.

signature.description: Identity-key signature over the signed pre-key public key (Base64).

OneTimePreKey.description: A Signal one-time pre-key, consumed once when a peer opens a session.

keyId.description: Client-assigned id of this one-time pre-key.

KeysUploadRequest.description: Uploads the caller's Signal pre-key bundle (identity, registration id, signed pre-key, and a pool of one-time pre-keys), replacing any previous bundle. Sent on first login of a new device.

identityKey.description: The caller's long-lived Curve25519 identity public key (Base64).

oneTimePreKeys.description: Initial pool of one-time pre-keys; the server hands one out per session and deletes it.

PreKeysUploadRequest.description: Replenishes the caller's pool of one-time pre-keys when it runs low.

oneTimePreKeys.description: Additional one-time pre-keys to append to the caller's pool.

PreKeyCountResponse.description: How many one-time pre-keys the caller still has in the directory, so the client can top up below a threshold. Also carries the caller's currently published identity key so a re-used device can detect a stale directory entry and re-publish.

count.description: Remaining one-time pre-keys in the caller's pool.

identityKey.description: The caller's Curve25519 identity public key currently stored in the directory (Base64), or absent if the caller has no directory entry.

PublicKeySet.description: A user's Signal pre-key bundle as served by the directory: identity, registration id, signed pre-key, and at most one one-time pre-key (absent when the pool is exhausted).

uploadedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when this bundle was uploaded to the directory.

userId.description: The user id these public keys belong to.

messageId.description: ID of the original message this receipt refers to.

recipientId.description: ID of the user who delivered/read the message (the original recipient).

signature.description: Signature over (messageId, type, originalSenderId) by the recipient's identity key (Base64), relayed unaltered from the submitted DeliveryReceipt.

MessageEvent.description: WS push: a new encrypted message relayed live by the Hub.

ReceiptEvent.description: WS push: a delivery/read/undecryptable notification relayed live to the original sender.

joinedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the member joined the group.

name.description: Human-readable group name (stored in plaintext server-side).

ownerId.description: The group owner — the sole party permitted to change the roster.

avatarUrl.description: Group avatar image as a base64 data URL, if set.

createdAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the group was created.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last roster change.

GroupSummary.description: Lightweight group descriptor for list views.

CreateGroupRequest.description: Creates a group with the caller as owner and the given initial roster.

members.description: Initial member user ids (the owner is added automatically if omitted).

avatarUrl.description: Optional group avatar image as a base64 data URL.

add.description: User ids to add to the roster.

remove.description: User ids to remove from the roster.

UpdateGroupRequest.description: Owner-only partial update of a group's metadata. Only the provided fields are changed.

name.description: New group name (plaintext). Omit to leave unchanged.

avatarUrl.description: Base64 data URL to set the avatar, an empty string to clear it, or omit to leave it unchanged.

HubRegistrationRequest.description: Sent by a Hub to the Server on boot to obtain its relay queue. Authentication is via the registration bearer token (a shared secret in Phase 1; a dashboard-issued per-Hub token later). The body itself carries no trust.

instanceId.description: Optional Hub-chosen instance label reported for diagnostics/dashboard display only. The Server does not derive identity or trust from it; the authoritative hubId is assigned by the Server.

hubId.description: Server-assigned identifier for this Hub registration. Names the Hub's queue and (in the volunteer phase) ties it to an owner for accountability and revocation.

queueName.description: Name of the auto-delete queue the Server provisioned for this Hub. The Hub binds user routing keys to it and consumes it; the Hub never declares queues itself.

exchange.description: Name of the topic exchange the Hub binds user routing keys against (messages.exchange).

PushSubscriptionKeys.description: The client keys of a Web Push (VAPID) subscription, used by the Server to encrypt push payloads end-to-end to the browser push service.

p256dh.description: The subscription's P-256 ECDH public key (Base64url), as produced by the browser PushManager.

auth.description: The subscription's auth secret (Base64url), as produced by the browser PushManager.

PushSubscription.description: A browser Web Push (VAPID) subscription registered by an authenticated client so the Server can wake an offline recipient.

endpoint.description: The push service endpoint URL the Server delivers encrypted pushes to.

expirationTime.description: Optional epoch milliseconds at which the subscription expires, if the browser provided one.
